exposure: Persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: The study included 55 children, aged one to five years, who were born at >=34 weeks of gestational age, had PPHN treated with inhaled nitric oxide in a neonatal intensive care unit between January 2015 and December 2019, and whose parents completed an ASQ-3 questionnaire.
finding: The study found a significant prevalence (47%) of pathological neuro-psychomotor developmental scores in at least one of five studied domains, primarily communication (25%) and individual and social skills (22%), in children aged 1-5 years with a history of PPHN.
followup_time: Up to 5 years after birth (60 months)
